Meet Medsien

Our Story

When you think of serial entrepreneurs, your first thought is likely of self-driving cars or space travel, not healthcare. And we think that’s precisely the problem. We founded Medsien to build the most advanced technology for the industry that needs it most, because, above all, we want to make a real impact in people’s lives, today and for the rest of their days.

Hamed Ahmadi and Sina Torabi, Co-founders

More than 60% of all U.S. adults, over 150 million people, live with at least one chronic condition

And yet, only 20% of these patients have access to remote care from the comfort of their homes.

Living with a chronic condition · 60 in 100

Of them, with remote care at home · 12 in 100

Reliability, efficiency, and compassion: these are the key pillars of a quality patient experience

Our mission at Medsien is to enable medical providers with unparalleled technology solutions that can power up their practices.

We believe in a world where healthcare is as easily accessible and technologically advanced as same-day delivery.

As the leading provider of scalable remote care management, Medsien is here to remove the barriers to achieving the best quality of life.

Our Core Values

Trust

We act with integrity and uphold the highest ethical standard of care. As reliable sources of technical expertise, we operate with transparency at the forefront.

Harmony

We aim to simplify and streamline each component of quality care, so the connections between patients and providers are seamless.

Empathy

We put people first, leading with kindness in every interaction. Whether personally or professionally, we seek to strengthen our relationships to achieve our shared goals.

Remote-First Remote Care

We can’t power medical practices beyond their four walls while confined to offices of our own. Founded in San Francisco, Medsien employs a fully remote team across the US and Türkiye.

Chronic Care Management (CCM) Overview & Benefits

The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) defines chronic conditions as those in which the patient is at significant risk of death, acute exacerbation/decompensation, or functional decline, and are expected to last until the death of the patient.

Learn more

Transitional Care Management (TCM) Overview & Benefits

Transitional Care Management is a program designed to support and track Medicare patients in the 30 days following discharge from a hospital or treatment facility.

Learn more

Annual Wellness Visit (AWV) Overview & Benefits

The Annual Wellness Visit (AWV) is a Medicare specific annual health status check where patients have vitals and health status indicators assessed, to provide an opportunity for earlier support and intervention for chronic conditions or concerns.

Learn more
